attributes.action: This Petition title is that The nessie should be the national animal of scotland
attributes.additional_details: This petition is about Scotland to change the national animal from The Unicorn to the Mystical nessie loch ness monster
attributes.background: The nessie is a mystical scottish animal that has a lot of history and i think the unicorn has nothing to do with scotland so my idea for this petition is us scottish people want the nessie to be the national animal

rejection.details: This is the responsibility of the Scottish Parliament.
